item.title: Narikiri Bakappuru! "Hontou wa, Anta to Nante Ichaicha Shitakunain Dakara ne!"
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Nel
  • 発売日: 2010-01-29
  • スコア: 7.01/10 (25 人評価)
  • 日本語名: なりきりバカップル！「本当は、アンタとなんてイチャイチャしたくないんだからねっ！」
  • 英語名: Narikiri Bakappuru! “Hontou wa, Anta to Nante Ichaicha Shitakunain Dakara ne!”

あらすじ

Shinichi is a pretty typical guy, except that his childhood friend who lives next door is one of the smartest and most beautiful girls in the school. Her name is Kanami and their relationship is akin to siblings since they’ve been together for so long. One day when they were taking shelter from the rain, they accidentally broke an old relic and Hiwa, the fox spirit that rules over the land, punished them by placing a curse on them. Soon, the school views them as a couple and their parents wants them to marry, even though they don’t have feelings for each other. The only way to break this ‘curse’ is to kiss each other whenever they’re told to.

item.title: Kijoku: Princess Double Gari
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Nel
  • 発売日: 2003-05-30
  • スコア: 6.890000000000001/10 (19 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 姫辱－きじょく－プリンセスダブル狩り
  • 英語名: Kijoku: Princess Double Gari

别名

  • Hime Joku -Kijoku- Princess Double Gari

あらすじ

Distol El Asteria, prince of Asteria, endured 8 humiliating years as a hostage in Baltrage following his mother’s miserable death during captivity. He closes his heart and trains intensely in swordsmanship and knowledge to protect loved ones. Despite his royal status, he’s treated as a nuisance except by Baltrage’s first princess, Irina.
